items.description: Wheeling over the rail still scrolled the whole page. The pane height was 100dvh, but the top status bar (41px) and the app wrapper padding (32px) sit outside it, so the page stayed 73px taller than the viewport and the wheel fell through to it. The height now subtracts both, the page is exactly viewport-tall, and the wheel has nowhere to go except the pane under the cursor.
